_comment: BindCraft target settings - APPROACH B support: small-site Loop 2 binder.
This is the minibinder control arm that runs alongside the RFpeptides
macrocycle campaign (configs/rfpeptides/). Same site, two chemistries - if the
macrocycles fail you still learn whether the site is engageable at all, and if
both work the minibinder gives you an affinity reagent for the peptide assay.
Site: Loop 2 of chain A plus the rim of chain B only, so the binder is driven
into the shallow groove around the exposed F326 rather than being allowed to
sprawl over the whole three-fold crown.
Hotspots: F326 (SASA 149, the anchor), L322 (114), K327 (126).
Shorter length range than the other campaigns - this is a small, shallow,
partly polar site and long binders will simply drape across it.
VERIFY key names against your installed BindCraft settings_target/*.json.
